# Elbow plots

**GOAL**: Check dimensions of interest in dimensionality reductions

```{r ElbowPlots}
pltList<-list()
# Standard deviation per PC is already calculated 
# Visualization performed via ElbowPlot
pltList<-append(pltList, 
                list(ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca.unintegrated.rna")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "Unintegrated PCA on RNA assay"),
                     ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca.unintegrated.adt")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "Unintegrated PCA on ADT assay",
                                   x = "PC")))

# Standard deviation of new integration components not calculated automaticatlly
Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.cca.rna"]]@stdev<-as.numeric(
  apply(Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.cca.rna"]]@cell.embeddings,
        MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){sd(x)}))
pltList<-append(pltList,
                list(ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "integrated.cca.rna")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "CCA integration on RNA assay",
                                   x = "CCA")))

Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.cca.adt"]]@stdev<-as.numeric(
  apply(Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.cca.adt"]]@cell.embeddings,
        MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){sd(x)}))
pltList<-append(pltList,
                list(ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "integrated.cca.adt")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "CCA integration on ADT assay",
                                   x = "CCA")))

Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.rpca.rna"]]@stdev<-as.numeric(
  apply(Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.rpca.rna"]]@cell.embeddings,
        MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){sd(x)}))
pltList<-append(pltList,
                list(ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "integrated.rpca.rna")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "RPCA integration on RNA assay",
                                   x = "RPCA")))

Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.rpca.adt"]]@stdev<-as.numeric(
  apply(Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["integrated.rpca.adt"]]@cell.embeddings,
        MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){sd(x)}))
pltList<-append(pltList,
                list(ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "integrated.rpca.adt")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "RPCA integration on ADT assay",
                                   x = "RPCA")))

Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["harmony.rna"]]@stdev<-as.numeric(
  apply(Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["harmony.rna"]]@cell.embeddings,
        MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){sd(x)}))
pltList<-append(pltList,
                list(ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "harmony.rna")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "Harmony integration on RNA assay",
                                   x = "Harmony")))

Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["harmony.adt"]]@stdev<-as.numeric(
  apply(Integrated_RNA_ADT@reductions[["harmony.adt"]]@cell.embeddings,
        MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){sd(x)}))
pltList<-append(pltList,
                list(ElbowPlot(Integrated_RNA_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "harmony.adt")+
                       themeG+labs(title = "Harmony integration on ADT assay",
                                   x = "Harmony")))

# Plot elbowplots
ggarrange(plotlist=pltList,
          ncol = 2, nrow = 4)
ggsave(filename = paste0(params$suffix_output,"_ElbowPlots_Reductions.jpeg"),
       device = "jpeg", path = path_Results,
       bg = 'white', height = 15, width = 10)
```

**CONCLUSION**: Dim 20 is okay!

# Clustree

**GOAL**: Check clustering resolution (both for RNA and ADT data)

```{r Clustree_RNA}
#### RNA ####
# CCA integration
ClusTree_CCA<-clustree(Integrated_RNA_ADT, 
                   # Select only the correct clusters based on the resolution
                   prefix = "cca_clusters_rna_res_",
                   suffix = "",
                   # Size of the nodes
                   node_size = 6,
                   # Edges cross as little a possible
                   layout = "sugiyama",
                   # Coloring the nodes based on fraction of B cells
                   # Per cluster 
                   node_colour = "predicted.celltype.l1",
                   node_colour_aggr = "B_Frac",
                   show_axis = TRUE)
ClusTree_CCA<-ClusTree_CCA+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey",
                       high = "#A00D0D")+
  scale_edge_color_continuous(low = "lightgrey",
                             high = "#690F82")+
  labs(edge_alpha = "Proportion moved cells",
       edge_colour = "Counts moved cells",
       colour = "B cell fraction",
       title = "CCA Integration",
       subtitle = "RNA")+
  ylab("Resolution")+
  theme_clustree

# RPCA integration
ClusTree_RPCA<-clustree(Integrated_RNA_ADT, 
                   # Select only the correct clusters based on the resolution
                   prefix = "rpca_clusters_rna_res_",
                   suffix = "",
                   # Size of the nodes
                   node_size = 6,
                   # Edges cross as little a possible
                   layout = "sugiyama",
                   # Coloring the nodes based on fraction of B cells
                   # Per cluster 
                   node_colour = "predicted.celltype.l1",
                   node_colour_aggr = "B_Frac",
                   show_axis = TRUE)
ClusTree_RPCA<-ClusTree_RPCA+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey",
                       high = "#A00D0D")+
  scale_edge_color_continuous(low = "lightgrey",
                             high = "#690F82")+
  labs(edge_alpha = "Proportion moved cells",
       edge_colour = "Counts moved cells",
       colour = "B cell fraction",
       title = "RPCA Integration",
       subtitle = "RNA")+
  ylab("Resolution")+
  theme_clustree

# Harmony integration
ClusTree_Harmony<-clustree(Integrated_RNA_ADT, 
                   # Select only the correct clusters based on the resolution
                   prefix = "harmony_clusters_rna_res_",
                   suffix = "",
                   # Size of the nodes
                   node_size = 6,
                   # Edges cross as little a possible
                   layout = "sugiyama",
                   # Coloring the nodes based on fraction of B cells
                   # Per cluster 
                   node_colour = "predicted.celltype.l1",
                   node_colour_aggr = "B_Frac",
                   show_axis = TRUE)
ClusTree_Harmony<-ClusTree_Harmony+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey",
                       high = "#A00D0D")+
  scale_edge_color_continuous(low = "lightgrey",
                             high = "#690F82")+
  labs(edge_alpha = "Proportion moved cells",
       edge_colour = "Counts moved cells",
       colour = "B cell fraction",
       title = "Harmony Integration",
       subtitle = "RNA")+
  ylab("Resolution")+
  theme_clustree

# Print ClusTrees
ClusTree_CCA         
ClusTree_RPCA         
ClusTree_Harmony      

# Save ClusTrees
ggsave(plot = ClusTree_CCA,
       filename = paste(params$suffix_output, "ClusTree_CCA_RNA.jpeg",
                        sep = "_"),
       path = file.path(path_Results, "ClusTrees"),
       bg = "white", height = 6, width = 15)
ggsave(plot = ClusTree_RPCA,
       filename = paste(params$suffix_output,
                        "ClusTree_RPCA_RNA.jpeg",
                        sep = "_"),
       path = file.path(path_Results, "ClusTrees"),
       bg = "white", height = 6, width = 15)
ggsave(plot = ClusTree_Harmony,
       filename = paste(params$suffix_output,
                        "ClusTree_Harmony_RNA.jpeg",
                        sep = "_"),
       path = file.path(path_Results, "ClusTrees"),
       bg = "white", height = 6, width = 15)

# Clean up workspace
rm(ClusTree_CCA, ClusTree_RPCA, ClusTree_Harmony, Integrated_RNA)
```

**CONCLUSION**:

| Integration Method | Resolution |
|:------------------:|:----------:|
|        CCA         |    1.5     |
|        RPCA        |    1.5     |
|      Harmony       |    1.5     |

```{r FinalIntData}
# Adapt if necessary (depends on the ClusTree output)
Res_Method_RNA<-c("CCA" = 1.5,
                  "RPCA" = 1.5,
                  "Harmony" = 1.5)
Res_Method_ADT<-c("CCA" = 2,
                  "RPCA" = 2,
                  "Harmony" = 2)

Res_Method_RNA[]<-paste0(c("cca_clusters_rna_res_", "rpca_clusters_rna_res_",
                         "harmony_clusters_rna_res_"),Res_Method_RNA)
Res_Method_ADT[]<-paste0(c("cca_clusters_adt_res_", "rpca_clusters_adt_res_",
                         "harmony_clusters_adt_res_"),Res_Method_ADT)

# Only retain clusters of resolution of interest
IntData<-SelectMetaData(object = Integrated_RNA_ADT,
                        to_stay = c("cca_clusters_rna" = Res_Method_RNA[["CCA"]],
                                    "harmony_clusters_rna" = Res_Method_RNA[["Harmony"]],
                                    "rpca_clusters_rna" = Res_Method_RNA[["RPCA"]],
                                    "cca_clusters_adt" = Res_Method_ADT[["CCA"]],
                                    "harmony_clusters_adt" = Res_Method_ADT[["Harmony"]],
                                    "rpca_clusters_adt" = Res_Method_ADT[["RPCA"]]),
                        pattern_remove = "_res.*")
# Clean up workspace
rm(Integrated_RNA_ADT, Res_Method_ADT, Res_Method_RNA)
```

# UMAP

**GOAL**: Visualisation of cells using a UMAP, coloring varies based on cell annotation

```{r UMAP_Visualisation_RNA}
# Function DimPlot_Integration is defined above
# CCA 
ggarrange(plotlist = list(
  DimPlot_Integration(reduction = "umap.cca.rna",
                      colors = "cca_clusters_rna",
                      title = "CCA clusters"),
  DimPlot_Integration(reduction = "umap.cca.rna",
                      colors = "predicted.celltype.l1",
                      title = "Predicted cell types, level 1"),
  DimPlot_Integration(reduction = "umap.cca.rna",
                      colors = "predicted.celltype.l2",
                      title = "Predicted cell types, level 2",
                      label = FALSE, legend = FALSE),
  DimPlot_Integration(reduction = "umap.cca.rna",
                      colors = "Stimulation",
                      title = "Stimulation",
                      label = FALSE,
                      legend = TRUE)+
    scale_color_manual(values = colors),
  DimPlot_Integration(reduction = "umap.cca.rna",
                      colors = "samplename",
                      title = "Pooled sample",
                      label = FALSE, legend = TRUE)+
    scale_color_manual(values = colors),
  DimPlot_Integration(reduction = "umap.cca.rna",
                      colors = "TimePoint",
                      title = "Time point",
                      label = FALSE, legend = TRUE)+
    scale_color_manual(values = colors,
                       labels = c("0h","8h","30h"))),
  ncol = 2, nrow = 3)

ggsave(filename = paste(params$suffix_output,
                        "UMAP_CCA_RNA.jpeg",
                        sep = "_"),
       bg = "white",
       path = file.path(path_Results, "DimRed_UMAPs"),
       device = "jpeg",
       width = 12, height = 17)
  
# RPCA

  DimPlot_Integration(reduction = "umap.rpca.rna",
                      colors = "rpca_clusters_rna",
```

# WNN UMAP

**GOAL**: Generate a WNN graph and clustering by integrating both RNA and ADT data

```{r WNN_UMAP, echo=FALSE}
# Dimensionality reduction for WNN UMAP
IntData <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(IntData,
                                   # PCA reduction lists to find neighbors
                                   reduction.list = list("integrated.cca.rna",
                                                         "integrated.rpca.adt"),
                                   dims.list = list(1:30, 1:30),
                                   # Renaming outputs
                                   modality.weight.name = "RNA.weight.WNN_CCA_RPCA",
                                   snn.graph.name = "wnn_cca_rpca.snn",
                                   knn.graph.name = "wnn_cca_rpca.knn",
                                   weighted.nn.name = "weighted.nn_cca.rpca")

IntData <- RunUMAP(IntData, 
                   nn.name = "weighted.nn_cca.rpca", 
                   reduction.name = "umap.cca_rpca",
                   reduction = "integrated.cca.rna")

# Decide which resolution is appropriate
for (val_res in seq(0.5,2.5, by=0.5)){
  ResVal<-paste0("wnn_clusters_res_", val_res)
  print(paste0("Busy working on wnn_cca_rpca clustering with resolution ", val_res))
  IntData<-FindClusters(IntData, resolution=val_res, verbose = FALSE, 
                        cluster.name = ResVal,
                        graph.name = "wnn_cca_rpca.snn")}
```

**GOAL**: Check clustering resolution of WNN graph

```{r ClusTree_WNN}
ClusTree_WNN<-clustree(IntData, 
                   # Select only the correct clusters based on the resolution
                   prefix = "wnn_clusters_res_",
                   # Size of the nodes
                   node_size = 6,
                   # Edges cross as little a possible
                   layout = "sugiyama",
                   # Coloring the nodes based on fraction of B cells
                   # Per cluster 
                   node_colour = "predicted.celltype.l1",
                   node_colour_aggr = "B_Frac",
                   show_axis = TRUE)
ClusTree_WNN<-ClusTree_WNN+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey",
                       high = "#A00D0D")+
  scale_edge_color_continuous(low = "lightgrey",
                             high = "#690F82")+
  labs(edge_alpha = "Proportion moved cells",
       edge_colour = "Counts moved cells",
       colour = "B cell fraction",
       title = "WNN clusters",
       subtitle = "CCA (RNA) and RPCA (ADT)")+
  ylab("Resolution")+
  theme_clustree

# Print ClusTrees
ClusTree_WNN       # Resolution = 1.5

# Save ClusTrees
ggsave(plot = ClusTree_WNN,
       filename = paste(params$suffix_output,
                        "ClusTree_WNN_CCA_RPCA.jpeg",
                        sep = "_"),
       path = file.path(path_Results, "ClusTrees"),
       bg = "white", height = 6, width = 15, limitsize = FALSE)
rm(ClusTree_WNN)

# Store the clusters associated to the correct resolution
Res_Method_WNN<-c("WNN_CCA_RPCA" = 1.5)
Res_Method_WNN[]<-paste0("wnn_clusters_res_",Res_Method_WNN)

IntData<-SelectMetaData(object = IntData,
                        to_stay = c("cca_rpca_clusters.wnn" = Res_Method_WNN[["WNN_CCA_RPCA"]]),
          pattern_remove = "wnn_clusters_res")

```

## Step 1: Extract cluster information

Tables or stored in `.xlsx` files:

-   All DE genes and proteins per cluster (over all cells)
    -   For clusters based on the RNA expression (CCA integration method)
    -   For clusters based on the combination of RNA and ADT expression (CCA (RNA) and RPCA (ADT) combined using WNN integration method)
-   Top 5 DE genes and proteins per cluster (over all cells)
-   Total number of cells per cluster
-   Fraction of cell types per cluster (based on the labeling obtained via Azimuth, first and second annotation level are used)

```{r DE_AllCells}
#######
# Perform on WNN UMAP clusters

# Identification of differentially expressed genes/proteins
Idents(IntData)<-"cca_rpca_clusters.wnn"
# RNA
DiffMarkers_AllG_WNN <- FindAllMarkers(IntData, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, 
                            assay="RNA",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")

DiffMarkers_AllG_WNN<-DiffMarkers_AllG_WNN%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                        # Factorization of the clusters
                        levels = levels(DiffMarkers_AllG_WNN$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                        ordered=TRUE),
         # DE score
         Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# ADT
DiffMarkers_AllP_WNN <- FindAllMarkers(IntData, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, 
                            assay="ADT",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")
DiffMarkers_AllP_WNN<-DiffMarkers_AllP_WNN%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                        # Factorization of the clusters
                        levels = levels(DiffMarkers_AllP_WNN$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                        ordered=TRUE),
         # DE score
         Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# Save the top 5 genes/proteins in data frame
TopDE_All_WNN<-data.frame()
for (i in levels(IntData$cca_rpca_clusters.wnn)){
  TopDE_All_WNN<-rbind(TopDE_All_WNN,
                   data.frame(cluster = i,
                               # Necessary for wider format
                               Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:5)),
                                           paste0("protein", c(1:5))),
                               Name = c((DiffMarkers_AllG_WNN%>%filter(cluster == i))
                                        # Extract genes
                                        [1:5, "gene"],
                                        # Extract proteins
                                        (DiffMarkers_AllP_WNN%>%filter(cluster == i))
                                        [1:5, "gene"])))
}
# To wider format
TopDE_All_WNN<-TopDE_All_WNN%>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = Name,
              names_from = Feature)%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(x = cluster,
                        levels = cluster%>%
                          as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                        ordered = TRUE))%>%
  arrange(cluster)

# Save and clear workspace
# All markers
write.xlsx(x = DiffMarkers_AllG_WNN, file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/AllCells_Markers", 
                                                      paste(params$suffix_output, "DEGenesProteins_AllCellClusters_WNN.xlsx", 
                                                            sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "DE_Genes", col.names  = T, row.names = F)
write.xlsx(x = DiffMarkers_AllP_WNN, file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/AllCells_Markers", 
                                                      paste(params$suffix_output, "DEGenesProteins_AllCellClusters_WNN.xlsx", 
                                                            sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "DE_Proteins", col.names  = T, row.names = F, 
           append = T)
# Top 5 markers
write.xlsx(x = as.data.frame(TopDE_All_WNN%>%select(!starts_with("protein"))),
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/AllCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top5_DEGenesProteins_AllCellClusters_WNN.xlsx",
                                  sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "TopDE_Genes", col.names = T, row.names = F, showNA = F)
write.xlsx(x = as.data.frame(TopDE_All_WNN%>%select(!starts_with("gene"))),
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/AllCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top5_DEGenesProteins_AllCellClusters_WNN.xlsx",
```

```{r Azimuth_Proportions}
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/AllCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top5_DEGenesProteins_AllCellClusters_RNA.xlsx",
                                  sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "CellType_L1_Fractions", col.names = T, row.names = F, showNA = F,
           append = T)
write.xlsx(x = AzimuthProp_RNA_L2,
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/AllCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top5_DEGenesProteins_AllCellClusters_RNA.xlsx",
                                  sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "CellType_L2_Fractions", col.names = T, row.names = F, showNA = F,
           append = T)
rm(AzimuthProp_RNA_L1, AzimuthProp_RNA_L2,
   AzimuthProp_WNN_L1, AzimuthProp_WNN_L2)
```

## Step 2: Selection of B, T and other cell subsets

**GOAL**: Original data set is split into three data sets: B cells, T cells and other cells

Selection criteria:

-   **Location** of the cells on the graph (manually)
-   Cell type **fraction** of the cluster (based on Azimuth annotation)
-   Check **DE marker genes or proteins**

```{r Extract_BCellClusters_RNA}
##### MANUAL ANNOTATION #####
# Clusters identified based on the violin plot (gene expression) --> excel for decision making
# See notes for further explanation
# For clusters based on RNA expression only
Man_Annot_RNA<-c("B_" = c(1,2,3,4,6,10,13,16,17,18,19,20,21,22,27),
                 "NK_" = c(9,24),
                 "CD8 T_" = c(7,11,14,23,25),
                 "CD4 T_" = c(0,5,8),
                 "other T_" = c(),
                 "Myeloid_" = c(12,15,26),
                 "Unclassified_" =c(28,29))
Man_Annot_RNA<-data.frame(Cluster = factor(Man_Annot_RNA,
                                              levels = c(min(Man_Annot_RNA):max(Man_Annot_RNA)),
                                              ordered = T),
                          CellType = names(Man_Annot_RNA)%>%gsub(pattern="_.*$",replacement = ""),
                          row.names = NULL)%>%
  mutate(Subset = case_when(
    grepl(pattern = "B$", x = CellType) ~ "B",
    grepl(pattern = "T$", x = CellType) ~ "T",
    TRUE ~ "Other"))

# Add to metadata of the seurat object
# Add annotation of cluster
IntData<-AddMetaData(IntData, 
            merge(data.frame(clusters = IntData@meta.data[["cca_clusters_rna"]],
                             CellID = colnames(IntData)),
                  Man_Annot_RNA%>%select(CellType, Cluster), 
                  by.x = "clusters", by.y = "Cluster", 
                  all.y = TRUE)%>%
              column_to_rownames(var = "CellID")%>%
              mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, 
                                        levels = unique(Man_Annot_RNA$CellType)%>%sort(),
                                        ordered = TRUE))%>%
              select(CellType),
            col.name = "ManAnnot_L1_RNA")
##### REMOVING OUTLIERS FROM CLUSTER 16 #####

CCA1_Min = -4.8
``` 

```{r Extract_BCellClusters_WNN}
# Add annotation of cluster

IntData<-AddMetaData(IntData,

                             CellID = colnames(IntData)),

                  by.x = "clusters", by.y = "Cluster", 
                  all = TRUE)%>%
              column_to_rownames(var = "CellID")%>%
              select(Subset),
            col.name = "ManAnnot_LymphoSubset_WNN")

##### AZIMUTH ANNOTATION
# Fraction of total data set based on the Azimuth labeling
# Final subset label based on the Azimuth labeling
# RNA based clusteres
Azim_Annot_RNA <- data.frame(RefAnn_L1 = table(IntData@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l1,
                                               IntData@meta.data$cca_clusters_rna)%>%
                               # Extract the most abundant cell type for that specific clusters 
                               # based on the annotation with the reference B cell dataset
                               apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN =function(x){
                                 tmp<-which.max(x)
                                 return (names(x)[tmp])}))%>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Cluster")%>%
  left_join(CalClusFrac(object = IntData, 
                         clusters = "cca_clusters_rna", 
                         feature = "predicted.celltype.l1", 
                         barplot = FALSE)[[1]]%>%
               filter(predicted.celltype.l1 == "B")%>%
               select(-predicted.celltype.l1),
             by = c("Cluster"="cca_clusters_rna"))%>%
  select(everything(), BCellFraction = Fraction)%>%
  arrange(-BCellFraction)%>%
  # Distinguish between B cell, T cell and other cell clusters
  mutate(Subset = case_when(
           grepl(pattern = "B$", x = RefAnn_L1) ~ "B",
           grepl(pattern = "T$", x = RefAnn_L1) ~ "T",
           TRUE ~ "Other"))

# Save subset in metadata of seurat object
IntData<-AddMetaData(IntData, 
            merge(data.frame(clusters = IntData@meta.data[["cca_clusters_rna"]],
                             CellID = colnames(IntData)),
                  Azim_Annot_RNA%>%select(Subset, Cluster), 
                  by.x = "clusters", by.y = "Cluster", 
                  all = TRUE)%>%
              column_to_rownames(var = "CellID")%>%
              select(Subset),
            col.name = "Azim_LymphoSubset_RNA")

# WNN based clusters
Azim_Annot_WNN <- data.frame(RefAnn_L1 = table(IntData@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l1,
                                               IntData@meta.data$cca_rpca_clusters.wnn)%>%
                               # Extract the most abundant cell type for that specific clusters 
                               # based on the annotation with the reference B cell dataset
                               apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN =function(x){
                                 tmp<-which.max(x)
                                 return (names(x)[tmp])}))%>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Cluster")%>%
  left_join(CalClusFrac(object = IntData, 
                         clusters = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn", 
                         feature = "predicted.celltype.l1", 
                         barplot = FALSE)[[1]]%>%
               filter(predicted.celltype.l1 == "B")%>%
               select(-predicted.celltype.l1),
             by = c("Cluster"="cca_rpca_clusters.wnn"))%>%
  select(everything(), BCellFraction = Fraction)%>%
  arrange(-BCellFraction)%>%
  # Distinguish between B cell, T cell and other cell clusters
  mutate(Subset = case_when(
           grepl(pattern = "B$", x = RefAnn_L1) ~ "B",
           grepl(pattern = "T$", x = RefAnn_L1) ~ "T",
           TRUE ~ "Other"))

# Save subset in metadata of seurat object
IntData<-AddMetaData(IntData, 
            merge(data.frame(clusters = IntData@meta.data[["cca_rpca_clusters.wnn"]],
                             CellID = colnames(IntData)),
                  Azim_Annot_WNN%>%select(Subset, Cluster),

              column_to_rownames(var = "CellID")%>%
```

## Step 3: Clustering of specific cell clusters

### B cells

**GOAL**: Clustering of B cell subset to annotate the individual cells

Conclusions are drawn based on the difference in expression rate of specific genes and/or proteins.

```{r ClusteringBCells}
##### CLUSTERING OF B CELL SUBSET #####
IntData_BCells <- Seurat::RunPCA(object = IntData_BCells,
                                 assay = "RNA",
                                 reduction.name = "B_integrated.cca.rna")

# Nearest neighbours graph generation based on CCA (only RNA) integration method
IntData_BCells <- FindNeighbors(IntData_BCells, 
                                reduction = "B_integrated.cca.rna", 
                                dims = 1:30, graph.name = "CCA_Int_B.rna")
# Clustering using multiple resolution values
for (val_res in seq(0.5,2.5, by=0.5)){
  ResVal<-paste0("B_cca_clusters_rna_res_", val_res)
  message(paste0("Busy working on CCA clustering with resolution ", val_res))
  IntData_BCells<-FindClusters(IntData_BCells,resolution=val_res,
                        verbose = FALSE, cluster.name = ResVal,
                        graph.name = "CCA_Int_B.rna")}
# Clustree to check the select the appropriate resolution
clustree(IntData_BCells, 
         # Select only the correct clusters based on the resolution
         prefix = "B_cca_clusters_rna_res_",
         # Size of the nodes
         node_size = 6,
         # Edges cross as little a possible
         layout = "sugiyama",
         # Coloring the nodes based on fraction of B cells
         # Per cluster 
         node_colour = "lightblue",
         show_axis = TRUE)+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey",
                       high = "#A00D0D")+
  scale_edge_color_continuous(low = "lightgrey",
                             high = "#690F82")+
  labs(edge_alpha = "Proportion moved cells",
       edge_colour = "Counts moved cells",
       colour = "B cell fraction",
       title = "CCA Integration",
       subtitle = "RNA")+
  ylab("Resolution")+
  theme_clustree
# Resolution of 2 seems okay 
# Better to overcluster, merging clusters is possible if necessary
Res_Method<-c("Resolution" = 2)
Res_Method[]<-paste0("B_cca_clusters_rna_res_",Res_Method)

IntData_BCells<-SelectMetaData(object = IntData_BCells,
                               to_stay = c("B_cca_clusters_rna" = Res_Method[["Resolution"]]),
                               pattern_remove = "B_cca_clusters_rna_res_")


IntData_BCells <- RunUMAP(IntData_BCells, 
                          reduction = "B_integrated.cca.rna", 
                          dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "B_umap.cca.rna")

##### VISUALISATION
ggarrange(plotlist = list(
            # Dimensionality reduction plot with cluster labels (RNA only)
            DimPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
                    group.by = "B_cca_clusters_rna",
                    reduction = "B_umap.cca.rna", 
                    label = TRUE)+
              labs(title = "B cell clusters",
                   subtitle = "New clustering, only B cells")+
              xlab("CCA_UMAP1")+
              ylab("CCA_UMAP2")+
              themeG+
              NoLegend(),
            # Dimensionality reduction plot with previous cluster labels (RNA only)
            DimPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
                    group.by = "cca_clusters_rna",
                    reduction = "B_umap.cca.rna", 
                    label = TRUE)+
              labs(title = "B cell clusters",
                   subtitle = "Old clustering, all cells")+
              xlab("CCA_UMAP1")+
              ylab("CCA_UMAP2")+
              themeG+
              NoLegend(),
            DimPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
                    group.by = "Stimulation",
                    reduction = "B_umap.cca.rna", 
                    label = F)+
              labs(title = "B cell clusters",
                   subtitle = "Stimulatory condition")+
              xlab("CCA_UMAP1")+
              ylab("CCA_UMAP2")+
              themeG+
              scale_color_manual(values = colorsStim)+
              theme(legend.justification=c(1,1.14),
                    legend.position=c(1,1.14))+
              guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3),
                                        ncol = 2)),
            DimPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
                    group.by = "TimePoint",
                    reduction = "B_umap.cca.rna",
```

### T cells

**GOAL**: Clustering of T cell subset to annotate the individual cells

Conclusions are drawn based on the difference in expression rate of specific genes and/or proteins.

```{r ClusteringTCells}
##### CLUSTERING OF T CELL SUBSET #####
IntData_TCells <- Seurat::RunPCA(object = IntData_TCells,
                                 assay = "RNA",
                                 reduction.name = "T_integrated.cca.rna")

# Nearest neighbours graph generation based on CCA (only RNA) integration method
IntData_TCells <- FindNeighbors(IntData_TCells, 
                                reduction = "T_integrated.cca.rna", 
                                dims = 1:30, graph.name = "CCA_Int_T.rna")
# Clustering using multiple resolution values
for (val_res in seq(0.5,2.5, by=0.5)){
  ResVal<-paste0("T_cca_clusters_rna_res_", val_res)
  message(paste0("Busy working on CCA clustering with resolution ", val_res))
  IntData_TCells<-FindClusters(IntData_TCells,resolution=val_res,
                        verbose = FALSE, cluster.name = ResVal,
                        graph.name = "CCA_Int_T.rna")}
# Clustree to check the select the appropriate resolution
clustree(IntData_TCells, 
         # Select only the correct clusters based on the resolution
         prefix = "T_cca_clusters_rna_res_",
         # Size of the nodes
         node_size = 6,
         # Edges cross as little a possible
         layout = "sugiyama",
         # Coloring the nodes based on fraction of T cells
         # Per cluster 
         node_colour = "lightblue",
         show_axis = TRUE)+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey",
                       high = "#A00D0D")+
  scale_edge_color_continuous(low = "lightgrey",
                             high = "#690F82")+
  labs(edge_alpha = "Proportion moved cells",
       edge_colour = "Counts moved cells",
       colour = "T cell fraction",
       title = "CCA Integration",
       subtitle = "RNA")+
  ylab("Resolution")+
  theme_clustree
# Resolution of 2 seems okay 
# Better to overcluster, merging clusters is possible if necessary
Res_Method<-c("Resolution" = 2)
Res_Method[]<-paste0("T_cca_clusters_rna_res_",Res_Method)

IntData_TCells<-SelectMetaData(object = IntData_TCells,
                               to_stay = c("T_cca_clusters_rna" = Res_Method[["Resolution"]]),
                               pattern_remove = "T_cca_clusters_rna_res_")


IntData_TCells <- RunUMAP(IntData_TCells, 
                          reduction = "T_integrated.cca.rna", 
                          dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "T_umap.cca.rna")

##### VISUALISATION
ggarrange(plotlist = list(
            # Dimensionality reduction plot with cluster labels (RNA only)
            DimPlot(object = IntData_TCells,
                    group.by = "T_cca_clusters_rna",
                    reduction = "T_umap.cca.rna", 
                    label = TRUE)+
              labs(title = "T cell clusters",
                   subtitle = "New clustering, only T cells")+
              xlab("CCA_UMAP1")+
              ylab("CCA_UMAP2")+
              themeG+
              NoLegend(),
            # Dimensionality reduction plot with previous cluster labels (RNA only)
            DimPlot(object = IntData_TCells,
                    group.by = "cca_clusters_rna",
                    reduction = "T_umap.cca.rna", 
                    label = TRUE)+
              labs(title = "T cell clusters",
                   subtitle = "Old clustering, all cells")+
              xlab("CCA_UMAP1")+
              ylab("CCA_UMAP2")+
              themeG+
              NoLegend(),
            DimPlot(object = IntData_TCells,
                    group.by = "Stimulation",
                    reduction = "T_umap.cca.rna", 
                    label = F)+
              labs(title = "T cell clusters",
                   subtitle = "Stimulatory condition")+
              xlab("CCA_UMAP1")+
              ylab("CCA_UMAP2")+
              themeG+
              scale_color_manual(values = colorsStim)+
              theme(legend.justification=c(1,1.14),
                    legend.position=c(1,1.14))+
              guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3),
                                        ncol = 2)),
            DimPlot(object = IntData_TCells,
                    group.by = "TimePoint",
                    reduction = "T_umap.cca.rna", 
                    label = F)+
              labs(title = "T cell clusters",
                   subtitle = "Incubation time")+
              xlab("CCA_UMAP1")+
              ylab("CCA_UMAP2")+
              themeG+
              scale_color_manual(values = colorsTime)+
              theme(legend.justification=c(1,1.14),
                    legend.position=c(1,1.14))+
              guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3),
                                        ncol = 2))),
          ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

ggsave(filename = paste(params$suffix_output,
                        "UMAP_RNAClusters_AllTCells.jpeg",
                        sep  ="_"),
       path = file.path(path_Results, "Markers", "TCells_Markers"),
       device = "jpeg", bg = "white",
       width = 13, height = 13)

saveRDS(IntData_TCells,
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, 
                         "SeuratObjects", 
                         paste0("seuratObj_CVID_",params$suffix_output,
                                "Split_integratedV5_TCellClusters.rds")))
```

```{r MyelCellClusters_Decomposition}
            mapping = aes(x = Myel_cca_clusters_rna,
                          y = Counts+50,
                          label = Counts),
            cex = 3.5,
            color = "black",
            angle = 45)+
  theme_bar+
  ylim(0,NA)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 8))+
  labs(fill = "Predicted cell type (L1)",
       y = "Number of cells",
       x = "Myeloid cell clusters")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorsL2_Other,
                    na.value = "#EEEEEE",
                    breaks = names(colorsL2_Other))+
  labs(title = "Azimuth annotation",
       subtitle = "CCA (RNA) and RPCA (ADT), WNN clusters")
```

## Step 4: Extract cluster information of specific cell types

**GOAL**: Extract differentially expressed genes and proteins per cell clusters per cell subtype

Tables or stored in `.xlsx` files:

-   All DE genes and proteins per cluster (over B or T cell clusters)
    -   For clusters based on the RNA expression (CCA integration method)
-   Top 5 DE genes and proteins per cluster (over all cells)
-   Total number of cells per cluster
-   Fraction of cell types per cluster (based on the labeling obtained via Azimuth, first and second annotation level are used)

### B cells

```{r DE_BCellClusters}
#######
# Perform on WNN UMAP clusters

# Identification of differentially expressed genes/proteins
Idents(IntData_BCells)<-"B_cca_clusters_rna"
# RNA
DiffMarkers_AllG_B <- FindAllMarkers(IntData_BCells, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, 
                            assay="RNA",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "B_cca_clusters_rna")

DiffMarkers_AllG_B<-DiffMarkers_AllG_B%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                        # Factorization of the clusters
                        levels = levels(DiffMarkers_AllG_B$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                        ordered=TRUE),
         # DE score
         Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# ADT
DiffMarkers_AllP_B <- FindAllMarkers(IntData_BCells, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, 
                            assay="ADT",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "B_cca_clusters_rna")
DiffMarkers_AllP_B<-DiffMarkers_AllP_B%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                        # Factorization of the clusters
                        levels = levels(DiffMarkers_AllP_B$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                        ordered=TRUE),
         # DE score
         Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# Save the top 5 genes/proteins in data frame
TopDE_All_B<-data.frame()
for (i in levels(IntData_BCells$B_cca_clusters_rna)){
  TopDE_All_B<-rbind(TopDE_All_B,
                   data.frame(cluster = i,
                               # Necessary for wider format
                               Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:50)),
                                           paste0("protein", c(1:50))),
                               Name = c((DiffMarkers_AllG_B%>%filter(cluster == i))
                                        # Extract genes
                                        [1:50, "gene"],
                                        # Extract proteins
                                        (DiffMarkers_AllP_B%>%filter(cluster == i))
                                        [1:50, "gene"])))
}
# To wider format
TopDE_All_B<-TopDE_All_B%>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = Name,
              names_from = Feature)%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(x = cluster,
                        levels = cluster%>%
                          as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                        ordered = TRUE))%>%
  arrange(cluster)

# Save and clear workspace
# All markers
write.xlsx(x = DiffMarkers_AllG_B, file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers", 
                                                      paste(params$suffix_output, "DEGenesProteins_AllBCellClusters_RNA.xlsx", 
                                                            sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "DE_Genes", col.names  = T, row.names = F)
write.xlsx(x = DiffMarkers_AllP_B, file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers", 
                                                      paste(params$suffix_output, "DEGenesProteins_AllBCellClusters_RNA.xlsx", 
                                                            sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "DE_Proteins", col.names  = T, row.names = F, 
           append = T)

# Top 5 markers
write.xlsx(x = as.data.frame(TopDE_All_B%>%select(!starts_with("protein"))),
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top50_DEGenesProteins_AllBCellClusters_RNA.xlsx",
                                  sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "TopDE_Genes", col.names = T, row.names = F, showNA = F)
write.xlsx(x = as.data.frame(TopDE_All_B%>%select(!starts_with("gene"))),
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top50_DEGenesProteins_AllBCellClusters_RNA.xlsx",
                                  sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "TopDE_Proteins", col.names = T, row.names = F, showNA = F,
           append = T)

# Clear workspace
rm(DiffMarkers_AllP_B, DiffMarkers_AllG_B,
   TopDE_All_B)
```

```{r Azimuth_Proportions_BCellClusters}
# Clusters based on combination of ADT and RNA (WNN)
# Calculate total number of cells in clusters
# Calculate fractions of each cell type in layer 1
AzimuthProp_B_L2<-left_join(x = CalClusCount(object = IntData_BCells,
                                            clusters = "B_cca_clusters_rna",
                                            feature = NULL, barplot = F)[[1]],
                           y = CalClusFrac(object = IntData_BCells, 
                                           clusters = "B_cca_clusters_rna",
                                           feature = "predicted.celltype.l2",
                                           barplot = F)[[1]]%>%
                             mutate(Fraction = Fraction * 100)%>%
                             pivot_wider(names_from = predicted.celltype.l2,
                                         values_from = Fraction),
                           by = "B_cca_clusters_rna")%>%
  select(clusters = B_cca_clusters_rna, 
         `Number of cells` = Counts,
         everything())%>%
  arrange(clusters)

write.xlsx(x = AzimuthProp_B_L2,
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top50_DEGenesProteins_AllBCellClusters_RNA.xlsx",
                                  sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "CellType_L2_Fractions", col.names = T, row.names = F, showNA = F,
           append = T)

rm(AzimuthProp_B_L2)
```

```{r Azimuth_Proportions_MyelCellClusters}
write.xlsx(x = AzimuthProp_Myel_L2,
           file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/MyelCells_Markers",
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "Top10_DEGenesProteins_AllMyelCellClusters_RNA.xlsx",
                                  sep = "_")),
           sheetName = "CellType_L2_Fractions", col.names = T, row.names = F, showNA = F,
           append = T)

rm(AzimuthProp_Myel_L2)
```

## ADJ: Step 2: Calculate fractions

The fraction of the cells in a particular sample (CEV ID) over the clusters is calculated. Consequently, the sum of the fractions per sample equals 1.

```{r FractionCalculation}
# Percentages per cluster
percentages_cluster_sample_B <- tibble(IntData_BCells@meta.data) %>% 
  # Per pooled sample en cluster
  group_by(Stimulation,cca_rpca_clusters.wnn, samplename, PatientID, TimePoint) %>% 
  # Total number of cells in that cluster
  dplyr::summarise(cells_in_sample_per_cluster= n()) %>% 
  # Calculate the percentages per pooled sample
  group_by(samplename, TimePoint) %>% 
  mutate(percentage_in_sample_per_cluster= cells_in_sample_per_cluster/sum(cells_in_sample_per_cluster),
         SampleID = paste(samplename, PatientID, TimePoint, Stimulation, sep = "_"))

# Adjust the format, add missing values
percentages_cluster_sample_B <- percentages_cluster_sample_B%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "SampleID",
              names_from = cca_rpca_clusters.wnn, 
              values_from=percentage_in_sample_per_cluster, 
              values_fill=0)%>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "SampleID")

# Mistake in metadata
rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_B)<-gsub(pattern = "_8_Baseline", 
                                             replacement = "_0_Baseline", 
                                             rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_B))
# Split in 8h and 30h
percentages_cluster_sample_B_8<-percentages_cluster_sample_B[
  grepl(pattern = "_8_",
       rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_B)),]
# Only retain the clusters proportions different from 0 for at least one sample
percentages_cluster_sample_B_8<-percentages_cluster_sample_B_8[,
                                                                (percentages_cluster_sample_B_8%>%
                                                                   colSums())!=0]

percentages_cluster_sample_B_30<-percentages_cluster_sample_B[
  grepl(pattern = "_30_",
       rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_B)),]
# Only retain the clusters proportions different from 0 for at least one sample
percentages_cluster_sample_B_30<-percentages_cluster_sample_B_30[,
                                                                (percentages_cluster_sample_B_30%>%
                                                                    colSums())!=0]

# Repeat for the non b cell clusters
# Percentages per cluster
percentages_cluster_sample_T <- tibble(IntData_TCells@meta.data) %>% 
  # Per pooled sample en cluster (take into account every sample separately!)
  group_by(Stimulation,cca_rpca_clusters.wnn, samplename, TimePoint, PatientID) %>% 
  # Total number of cells in that cluster
  dplyr::summarise(cells_in_sample_per_cluster= n()) %>% 
  # Calculate the percentages per pooled sample 
  group_by(samplename, TimePoint) %>% 
  mutate(percentage_in_sample_per_cluster= cells_in_sample_per_cluster/sum(cells_in_sample_per_cluster),
         SampleID = paste(samplename, PatientID, TimePoint, Stimulation, sep = "_"))

# Adjust the format, add missing values
percentages_cluster_sample_T <- percentages_cluster_sample_T%>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "SampleID",
              names_from = cca_rpca_clusters.wnn, 
              values_from=percentage_in_sample_per_cluster, 
              values_fill=0)%>%
  column_to_rownames(var="SampleID")
# Error in metadata
rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_T)<-gsub(pattern = "_8_Baseline", 
                                             replacement = "_0_Baseline", 
                                             rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_T))

# Split in 8h and 30h
# Split in 8h and 30h
percentages_cluster_sample_T_8<-percentages_cluster_sample_T[
  grepl(pattern = "_8_",
       rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_T)),]
# Only retain the clusters proportions different from 0 for at least one sample
percentages_cluster_sample_T_8<-percentages_cluster_sample_T_8[,
                                                                (percentages_cluster_sample_T_8%>%
                                                                   colSums())!=0]

percentages_cluster_sample_T_30<-percentages_cluster_sample_T[
  grepl(pattern = "_30_",
       rownames(percentages_cluster_sample_T)),]
# Only retain the clusters proportions different from 0 for at least one sample
percentages_cluster_sample_T_30<-percentages_cluster_sample_T_30[,
                                                                (percentages_cluster_sample_T_30%>%
                                                                    colSums())!=0]
rm(percentages_cluster_sample_B, percentages_cluster_sample_T)
```

## ADJ: Step 3: Principal component analysis (PCA)

We want to perform a PCA of the samples (stimulatory conditions) based on the fraction of the clusters within that sample.

```{r PCA_ClusterProportion}
# Perform PCA (only on numeric values)
# B cell clusters

             scale = TRUE,
             center = TRUE)
PC_B_30h<-prcomp(percentages_cluster_sample_B_30,
             scale = TRUE,
             center = TRUE)
# Non B cell clusters
# Perform PCA (only on numeric values)

             scale = TRUE,
             center = TRUE)
PC_other_30h<-prcomp(percentages_cluster_sample_other_30,
             scale = TRUE,
             center = TRUE)

# Visualize percentage of explained variance

fviz_eig(PC_B_30h)
fviz_eig(PC_other_8h)
fviz_eig(PC_other_30h)
```

The contribution (in percentages) of the different variables (in this case the clusters proportions per sample (=features)) gives an idea on how important specific variables are for the construction of each of the principal components.

```{r DetailsPCA}
print("### PC1 B cells 8 hours ###")
get_pca_var(PC_B_8h)$contrib[,1]%>%sort(decreasing = TRUE)
print("### PC2 B cells 8 hours ###")
get_pca_var(PC_B_8h)$contrib[,2]%>%sort(decreasing = TRUE)

### HIER VERDER!!!
ggarrange(plotlist = list(
  percentages_cluster_sample_B_8%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "SampleID")%>%
    pivot_longer(cols = !SampleID,
                 names_to = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn",
                 values_to = "Fraction")%>%
    filter(cca_rpca_clusters.wnn %in% (get_pca_var(PC_B_8h)$contrib[,1]%>%sort(decreasing = TRUE)%>%
             names())[1:5])%>%
    mutate(Patient = sapply(SampleID,
                       FUN = function(x){(strsplit(x, split = "_"))[[1]][2]}),
           Stimulation = sapply(SampleID,
                       FUN = function(x){(strsplit(x, split = "_"))[[1]][4]}),
```

## Step 8: Expression markers B cell clusters

**GOAL**: Extract list of cluster specific expression markers

**Parameters/thresholds**:

-   `features` = all genes needs to be tested (default)
-   `logfc.threshold` = limit testing to genes which show on average at least X-fold difference (log-scale) between the two groups of cells. Increasing speeds up the function, but can miss weaker signals (default = 0.25)
-   `test.use` = statistical test to use
-   `min.pct` = only test genes that are detected in a minimum fraction of `min.pct` of the cells in either of the two populations (default = 0.1)
-   `min.diff.pct` = only test genes that show a minimum difference in the fraction of detection between two groups (default = -Inf)
-   `only.pos` = only return positive markers (default = FALSE)
-   `return.thresh` = only return makers that have a p-value \< `return.thresh`, or a power \> `return.thresh` if test is ROC

**Outputs**:

-   FindAllMarkers function identifies gene markers for each cluster relative to all other clusters.
-   The expression for a given gene among cells in a given cluster is compared against the expression of that gene among cells in all other clusters.
-   `pct.1` = percentage of *cells in the cluster* where the gene is detected
-   `pct.2` = percentage of cells on average in all the *other clusters* where the gene is detected.
-   A gene to be considered as an *ideal* cluster marker is expected to be expressed *exclusively* in that cluster and silenced in all others and thus `pct.1` will be more towards 1 and `pct.2` towards 0.

```{r DE_GenesProteinsList}
# For the B cell clusters
Idents(IntData_BCells)<-"BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn"
# Find differentially expressed genes
DiffMarkers<-FindAllMarkers(IntData_BCells, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, assay="RNA",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")
# Factorize the clusters
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                         levels = levels(DiffMarkers$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                         ordered=TRUE))

# Calculate DE score (Noah)
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
  mutate(Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# Save the list
write.csv2(file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers", 
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "DEMarkerGenes_BCellClusters.csv", sep = "_")),
           x = DiffMarkers)

# Plot in heatplot
ggplot(DiffMarkers,
       mapping =aes(x = cluster,
                    y = gene,
                    fill = Score))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#97C7FF", 
                      high = "#002E84")+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank())+
  ylab("Genes")+
  xlab("B cell clusters")+
  labs(fill = "DE score")

# Focus on ADT data
DiffProteins<-FindAllMarkers(IntData_BCells, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.25, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, assay="ADT",
                            group.by = "BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")

# Factorize the clusters
DiffProteins<-DiffProteins%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                         levels = levels(DiffProteins$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                         ordered=TRUE))

# Calculate DE score (Noah)
DiffProteins<-DiffProteins%>%
  mutate(Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# Plot in heatplot
ggplot(DiffProteins,
       mapping =aes(x = cluster,
                    y = gene,
                    fill = Score))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#97C7FF", 
                      high = "#002E84")+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank())+
  ylab("Proteins")+
  xlab("B cell clusters")+
  labs(fill = "DE score")

# Save the list
write.csv2(file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers", 
                            paste(params$suffix_output, "DEMarkerProteins_BCellClusters.csv", sep = "_")),
           x = DiffProteins)
```

```{r DE_GenesProteins_MoreInDepth}
# Store the clusters
# Only use the clusters that consist of more than 3 cells
# Clusters_BCells<-(CalClusCount(object = IntData_BCells,
#                                clusters = "BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn",
#                                feature = "BCellCluster", barplot = F)[[1]]%>%
#                     # Filter based on the cell counts per cluster
#                     filter(Counts>3))[,1]
# RNA
# Initialization of a list containing the different clusters
DiffMarkers_List <- list()
# Performing differential gene/protein expression per cluster
for (i in Clusters_BCells){
  message(paste0("Working on cluster ", i))
  ident1 <- i # Extract 1 cluster
  ident2 <- Clusters_BCells[Clusters_BCells != i] # vs all
  table <- FindMarkers(IntData_BCells, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2 = ident2, 
                       min.diff.pct = 0.3, logfc.threshold = 0.3, assay = "RNA")
  if ( dim(table)[1] != 0 ){ # only when there is output
    # Store the genes in a separate row
    table <- rownames_to_column(table, var = "gene")
    # Specify the cluster
    table$cluster <- rep(i, nrow(table))
    # Calculate a DE score
    table$score <- table$pct.1 / (table$pct.2 + 0.01) * table$avg_log2FC
    # Rearranging the order of the genes based on the DE score
    table <- table%>%arrange(-score)
    # Store in list
    DiffMarkers_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]] <- table
  }
}

# Save the list
saveRDS(object = DiffMarkers_List,
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers",
                         paste(params$suffix_output, "DEMarkerGenes_BCellClusters_Expanded.rds", 
                               sep = "_")))

# ADT
# Initialization of a list containing the different clusters
DiffProteins_List <- list()
# Performing differential gene/protein expression per cluster
for (i in Clusters_BCells){
  message(paste0("Working on cluster ", i))
  ident1 <- i # Extract 1 cluster
  ident2 <- Clusters_BCells[Clusters_BCells != i] # vs all
  table <- FindMarkers(IntData_BCells, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2 = ident2, 
                       min.diff.pct = 0.3, logfc.threshold = 0.3, assay = "ADT")
  if ( dim(table)[1] != 0 ){ # only when there is output
    # Store the genes in a separate row
    table <- rownames_to_column(table, var = "gene")
    # Specify the cluster
    table$cluster <- rep(i, nrow(table))
    # Calculate a DE score
    table$score <- table$pct.1 / (table$pct.2 + 0.01) * table$avg_log2FC
    # Rearranging the order of the genes based on the DE score
    table <- table%>%arrange(-score)
    # Store in list
    DiffProteins_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]] <- table
  }
}

# Save the list
saveRDS(object = DiffProteins_List,
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers",
                         paste(params$suffix_output, "DEMarkerProteins_BCellClusters_Expanded.rds", 
                               sep = "_")))
```

```{r TopGenesProteins}
# Compare with list output FindMarkers

for (i in Clusters_BCells){

                                            [1:5, "gene"])))
    }
    else {
      # Only in DE genes available
      TopDE_Features2<-rbind(TopDE_Features2,
                        data.frame(cluster = i,
                                   # Necessary for wider format
                                   Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:5)),
                                               paste0("protein", c(1:5))),
                                   Name = c(DiffMarkers_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]]
                                            # Extract genes
                                            [1:5, "gene"],
                                            # Extract proteins
                                            rep(NA, 5))))
    }
  }
  else {
    # No DF available
    TopDE_Features2<-rbind(TopDE_Features2,
                      data.frame(cluster = i,
                                 # Necessary for wider format
                                 Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:5)),
                                             paste0("protein", c(1:5))),
                                 Name = c(rep(NA,10))))
  }
}

# Wider format
TopDE_Features2_W<-TopDE_Features2%>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = Name,
              names_from = Feature)
```

```{r ImpactStimulation_BCells}
for (stimulation in unique(IntData@meta.data$Stimulation)) {
  # Extract the number of cells in that cluster
  # Only focusing on the B cell subsets
  # For a specific stimulatory condition
  tmp<-data.frame(table(IntData@meta.data$cca_rpca_clusters.wnn, 
      IntData@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l2, 
      IntData@meta.data$Stimulation)[,
                                     c("B naive", "B intermediate", "B memory"),
                                     stimulation]/
    # Calculate the fractions in that cluster 'in percentage)
    rowSums(table(IntData@meta.data$cca_rpca_clusters.wnn, 
                 IntData@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l2, 
                 IntData@meta.data$Stimulation)[,
                                                c("B naive", "B intermediate", "B memory"),
                                                stimulation])*100)
  names(tmp)<-c("Clusters", "CellType", "Fraction")
  tmp<-tmp%>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = CellType,
                values_from = Fraction)%>%
    mutate(Clusters = as.numeric(Clusters)-1)%>%
    arrange(Clusters)%>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "Clusters")%>%
    mutate_all(~ifelse(is.nan(.), 0, .))
    
  print(Heatmap(tmp,
                col = colorRamp2(breaks = c(0, 20, 100),
                                 colors = c("white","#D7B8C9","#35075A")),
                name = stimulation,
                row_title = "Clusters",
                column_title = "",
                cluster_rows = T,
                show_row_dend = F,
                cluster_columns = F,
                row_names_side = "left",
                column_names_side = "top",
                column_names_rot = 0,
                column_names_centered = T,
                row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
                column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13)))
}
# Heatmap over the different stimulatory condtions
tmp<-data.frame(table(IntData@meta.data$Stimulation, 
                  IntData@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l2)[,c("B naive", "B intermediate", "B memory")]/
    # Calculate the fractions in that cluster 'in percentage)
    rowSums(table(IntData@meta.data$Stimulation, 
                 IntData@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l2)[,c("B naive", "B intermediate", "B memory")])*100)
  names(tmp)<-c("Stimulation", "CellType", "Fraction")
  tmp<-tmp%>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = CellType,
                values_from = Fraction)%>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "Stimulation")%>%
    mutate_all(~ifelse(is.nan(.), 0, .))
    
  print(Heatmap(tmp,
                col = colorRamp2(breaks = c(0, 30, 100),

                name = "Fraction",

                column_names_side = "top",
                column_names_rot = 0,
                column_names_centered = T,
                row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12),
                column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))
# Heatmap over the different stimulatory condtions

    # Calculate the fractions in that cluster 'in percentage)
    rowSums(table(IntData@meta.data$Stimulation,

names(tmp)<-c("Stimulation", "Clusters", "Fraction")

print(Heatmap(tmp,
```

## Step 11: CD21 expression based on stimulation

**Dot Plot visualization**: Feature expression changes accross different identity classes (clusters). The **size** of the dot encodes the **percentage** of cells withing a class. The **color** encodes the **average expression** level accross all cells within a class (blue is high).

CR2 gene encodes for the surface protein CD21 ([GeneCards CD21](https://www.genecards.org/cgi-bin/carddisp.pl?gene=CR2))

```{r DotPlot_Clusters}
Idents(IntData_BCells)<-"Stimulation"
DotPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
        features = c("TBX21", "CR2"),
        assay = "RNA",
        cols = rep("blue", times = levels(IntData_BCells@meta.data$cca_rpca_clusters.wnn)%>%length()),
        split.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn", 
        idents = c("MegaCD40L", "IFNgamma"))
ClusterSel<-c(37, 22, 20)
DotPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
        features = c("TBX21", "CR2"),
        assay = "RNA",
        idents = ClusterSel,
        cols = rep("#35075A", times = 6), 
        split.by = "Stimulation")
```

```{r CD21Expression}
Exp<-data.frame(CD21 = IntData_BCells@assays[["RNA"]]$scale.data["CR2",],
                Stimulation = IntData_BCells@meta.data['Stimulation'],
                Patient = IntData_BCells@meta.data['PatientID'],
                TimePoint = IntData_BCells@meta.data['TimePoint'],
                CellType = IntData_BCells@meta.data["predicted.celltype.l2"])%>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "CellID")%>%
  full_join(y = data.frame(TBet = IntData_BCells@assays[["RNA"]]$scale.data["TBX21",])%>%
              rownames_to_column(var = "CellID"),
            by = "CellID")%>%
  select(CD21, TBet, everything())%>%
  filter(TimePoint!=0)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("CD21", "TBet"),
               names_to = "Marker",
               values_to = "Expression")
ggplot(Exp) + 
  geom_density_ridges2(mapping = aes(x = Expression,
                     y = Stimulation,
                     fill = Stimulation),
                     alpha = 0.6,
                       bandwidth = 0.25)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorsStim)+
  #xlim(0.01,NA)+
  themeG+
  xlab("Normalized expression values")+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Marker),
             cols = vars(TimePoint),
             scales = "free_x")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  geom_segment(data = Exp%>%
                 filter(Expression!=0)%>%
                 group_by(Stimulation, TimePoint, Marker)%>%
                 summarise(Median = median(Expression)),
               mapping = aes(x = Median,
                             xend = Median,
                             y = Stimulation,
                             yend = as.numeric(as.factor(Stimulation))+0.8,
                             color  =Stimulation),
               alpha = 1, linewidth = 1)+
  geom_point(data = Exp%>%
                 filter(Expression!=0)%>%
                 group_by(Stimulation, TimePoint, Marker)%>%
                 summarise(Median = median(Expression)),
             mapping = aes(x = Median,
                           y = Stimulation,
                           color = Stimulation),
             shape = 20, size = 2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsStim)+
  ggtitle("All B cells")
```

# Cluster annotation

```{r WNN_Clusters}
# Read in the correct data
IntData<-readRDS(file = params$save_file_wnn)
# Overview clusters
# Counts per cluster
Clusters <- CalClusCount(object = IntData,
                         clusters = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn",
                         feature = NULL,
                         barplot = FALSE)[[1]]
# Fraction of total dataset
Clusters<-Clusters%>%
  mutate(Frac = Counts / sum(Counts),
         RefAnn_CellType1 = table(IntData@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l1, 
                                  IntData@meta.data$cca_rpca_clusters.wnn)%>%
           # Extract the most abundant cell type for that specific clusters 
           # based on the annotation with the reference B cell dataset
           apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN =function(x){
             tmp<-which.max(x)
             return (names(x)[tmp])}))
```

# Differential expression

*Interpretation of the output of `FindAllMarkers` function* FindAllMarkers function helps to identify gene markers for each cluster relative to all other clusters. The expression for a given gene among cells in a given cluster is compared against the expression of that gene among cells in all other clusters. In the output, *pct.1* is the percentage of *cells in the cluster* where the gene is detected, while *pct.2* is the percentage of cells on average in all the *other clusters* where the gene is detected. A gene to be considered as an *ideal* cluster marker is expected to be expressed exclusively in that cluster and silenced in all others and thus pct.1 will be more towards 1 and pct.2 towards 0.

```{r DifferentialExp}
# For the clusters
Idents(IntData)<-"cca_rpca_clusters.wnn"
# Find differentially expressed genes
DiffMarkers<-FindAllMarkers(IntData, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = TRUE, assay="RNA",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")
# Factorize the clusters
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                         levels = levels(DiffMarkers$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                         ordered=TRUE))

# Calculate DE score
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
  mutate(Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)

# Plot in heatplot
ggplot(DiffMarkers, mapping =aes(x = cluster,
                                 y = gene,
                                 fill = avg_log2FC))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_viridis()
DiffMarkers%>%filter(cluster == 1)%>%
  arrange(p_val_adj)

DiffProteins<-FindAllMarkers(IntData, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.25, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = TRUE, assay="ADT",
                            group.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")
DiffProteins%>%filter(cluster == 32)
```
